title: An agent fills a benefits application

intro.title: An agent fills a benefits application
intro.subtitle: Recorded, edited, and narrated automatically

outro.title: Stops before submission
outro.subtitle: A person always reviews and submits

steps.say: Here's how an agent can complete a benefits application from start to finish, using a synthetic client record.

steps.label: Start application
steps.say: It opens the county portal and starts a new application.

steps.label: Enter first name
steps.say: Then it fills in the applicant's details, one field at a time.

steps.label: Household of three
steps.say: Next, it answers the household questions and picks the programs the family needs.

steps.label: Review page
steps.say: And it stops at the review page, so a caseworker can check every answer before anything is submitted.
